LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Enlist_Letter_Label: A Thalmor agent has entered the colony in the embassy ledgers. The Thalmor pay well, and they will expect to be useful in return.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Enlist_Button_Desc: Offer the colony's loyalty to the Thalmor. They reward obedience, and they keep careful records.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Enlist_Requrements_Not_Sati: The Thalmor do not consider you reliable. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Faction: The Thalmor do not accept the service of their enemies.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Enlisted_With_Key: In the service of the Thalmor
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Missions_Desc: See what the embassy wants done.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Menu_Missions_Desc: Assignments from the embassy. Payment follows a satisfactory report.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Provisions_Desc: Fine food and good medicine from the embassy cellars.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Storage_Desc: Leave goods in the embassy's keeping.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave Thalmor service? The Thalmor do not take this lightly.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has withdrawn from Thalmor service. An agent made a note of it.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Resign_Button_Desc: End your arrangement with the Thalmor.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The Thalmor have decided the colony is a liability.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Salary_Desc: Dominion gold, counted out by a clerk who checks it twice.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Work_0_Desc: Listen in taverns and report what you hear. The Thalmor pay for names.
LanguageData.ESCP_Thalmor_Work_1_Desc: Read under the eye of a Thalmor mage.
